item.title: Kusatsu Onsen: Japan's Top-Ranked Hot Spring Town — Guide
item.description: Kusatsu Onsen has topped national rankings of Japan’s best hot spring resorts for years running, its reputation built on an extraordinarily high natural water output and strongly acidic, mineral-rich springs believed to have therapeutic properties. At the centre of town, the Yubatake (‘hot water field’) channels steaming spring water through wooden troughs in a striking, photogenic display, surrounded by dozens of ryokan, public bathhouses and souvenir shops that have made Kusatsu a beloved retreat since the Edo period.
